description_ru: Кандидат отвечает на вопросы менеджера на собеседовании в кафе.
text:
Manager: Good afternoon, Daniel. Please take a seat. Thank you for coming.
Daniel: Thank you for inviting me. I'm really pleased to be here.
Manager: Let's start with your experience. Have you ever worked in a café before?
Daniel: Yes, I have. I worked in a small coffee bar for two years while I was studying at university.
Manager: What did you enjoy most about it?
Daniel: Talking to the customers. I have always liked meeting new people, and I think a friendly smile can change someone's day.
Manager: That's good. This job is very busy, especially at lunchtime. How do you deal with stress?
Daniel: I try to stay calm and work step by step. If there are too many orders, I ask a colleague for help.
Manager: Excellent. Now, if we offered you the job, when could you start?
Daniel: I could start on the first of next month. I have finished my exams, so I'm free all summer.
Manager: We need people who can work on weekends. Would that be a problem?
Daniel: Not at all. I prefer weekends, because it is the busiest time, and the day passes quickly.
Manager: I like your attitude. We will make a decision by Friday, and I will call you either way.
Daniel: Thank you very much. I look forward to hearing from you.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Кончик языка поднят к нёбу, но не касается его и не вибрирует; губы слегка округлены. Это не русское «р».
Округлите губы в трубочку и быстро раздвиньте их; зубы не касаются нижней губы, иначе получится «в».
Короткий, расслабленный звук между «и» и «ы»; не растягивайте и не делайте его как русское «и».

questions.question: How does Daniel deal with stress?
questions.answer: He stays calm and asks a colleague for help.
